name: Central Amazon Conservation Complex
description: This vast stretch of Brazilian rainforest in the state of Amazonas is the largest protected area in the Amazon Basin. Its tangle of flooded forests, lakes and channels shifts constantly with the river, and includes the Anavilhanas archipelago in the Rio Negro. You might spot river dolphins, manatees, black caimans and giant arapaima, while the waters hold more kinds of electric fish than anywhere else on Earth.
